task: Indexed d-ary priority queue with change-key and arbitrary remove
reasoning_summary: Backed a d-ary heap with a position array so changeKey/remove are O(log n) and contains is O(1). Ties are broken by smaller id for determinism. Tests cover errors, arities 2-16 against a TreeSet model with many key ties, and a 20k-element ordering check; passed first attempt.
